ns2:section.sectionText: "Introduction to contemporary approaches to creating interactive music." Utilizing mobile iOS devices, MIDI controllers, game controllers, Arduino boards. OSC communication, and the SuperCollider audio programing language, and the SuperCollider , students complete four introductory two-week modules and pursue a final interactive music project. Concepts are primarily presented through prepared online instructional videos, with class time being used for workshopping, discussion, sharing works-in-progress, and troubleshooting. Intended for students who have completed 499C in Fall 2019 or students with a strong background in digital audio, computer programming, and/or electrical engineering. Instructor permission required.
